description: This PHP abstract class defines the base for handling Buzz video URLs within the OrangeHRM system, providing a URL property, constructor, getter, and an abstract method to obtain embedded URLs.

classes.name: AbstractBuzzVideoURL
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for Buzz video URL handling, including storage and retrieval of URL, and requiring implementation of method to get embedded URL.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a URL string.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to return the embedded video URL.
